name: Data Scientist
description: Formulate hypotheses, run A/B experiments, build predictive models, apply advanced statistical inference, and extract strategic business insights.

levels.title: Probability, Statistics & Hypothesis Testing
levels.description: Parametric/non-parametric tests, p-values, power analysis, A/B experiment design, and Bayesian statistics.

topics.title: A/B Testing & Statistical Power Analysis
topics.description: Sample size determination, minimum detectable effect (MDE), variance reduction (CUPED), and false positive control.

levels.title: Statistical Modeling & Feature Engineering
levels.description: GLMs, regularized regression (Lasso/Ridge), clustering, and advanced feature transforms.

topics.title: Feature Engineering & Dimensionality Reduction
topics.description: Target encoding, interaction terms, PCA, t-SNE, and feature importance interpretations.
